item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
I first came up with this last year, but I never posted it because I got somewhat mixed reviews from beta readers, mainly regarding the unusually long incident report near then end, which I'm well aware is not the norm for this format.

I do however want to use Iris having a collection of demon names as a plot point in a future tale, so I decided it was time just to post it and see what happened. If you did enjoy it, be sure to upvote.
